description: This file defines the Format class within the PhpSpreadsheet calculation library, implementing various formatting functions like DOLLAR, FIXED, TEXT, VALUE, and NUMBERVALUE for spreadsheet data. It handles formatting and conversion of cell values into different string representations and numeric formats.

classes.name: Format
classes.description: A class providing static methods for various data formatting functions within the PhpSpreadsheet library, including currency, fixed decimal, text, value parsing, and number conversion.

methods.name: DOLLAR
methods.description: Converts a number to a currency formatted string, rounding to specified decimal places.

methods.name: FIXEDFORMAT
methods.description: Formats a number with fixed decimal places, optionally including thousands separators.

methods.name: TEXTFORMAT
methods.description: Formats a value according to a specified number format string.

methods.name: VALUE
methods.description: Converts a formatted string into a number or date value.

methods.name: valueToText
methods.description: Converts a value to its text representation, with options for formatting.

methods.name: NUMBERVALUE
methods.description: Converts a string to a numeric value considering decimal and thousands separators.
